expectedPublicationDelay.delayDescription: Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of at least 1 day(s) between the publication date and published data.

temporalVariables.columnDescription: Temporal information of the value specified in the property 'valueCategory'.
temporalVariables.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of temporal value in the property 'temporal'.

georegion.columnDescription: Geographical unit of the data record.
georegion.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of geographical unit in the property 'georegion'.

subtype.columnDescription: Subtype specification used for grouping within the property 'type'.

testResult.typeColumnDescription: Specifies from which type of test the property 'testResult' was derived.

value.description: Represents the value defined by the property 'valueCategory' within the given temporal unit and grouping.

prct.description: Proportion of the entry in the property 'value' as percent within the given temporal unit and grouping.

lowerCi.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of the property 'prct'. The confidence intervals for SARS-CoV-2 variants in the genomic surveillance are estimated using the two-sided Goodman method for multinomial confidence intervals.

upperCi.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval of the property 'prct'. The confidence intervals for SARS-CoV-2 variants in the genomic surveillance are estimated using the two-sided Goodman method for multinomial confidence intervals.

dataComplete.description: Can data be assumed to be complete (few late reportings to be expected)?
